security_audit.summary: The audit confirmed a critical opaque remote-code-execution path in the installation instructions and a medium-risk command that can terminate an unrelated process on port 3100. Most other static hits are Markdown-formatting or documentation false positives, including the widespread Ruby-backtick matches.

remediation.issue: Opaque remote payload execution during installation
remediation.suggestion: Remove the curl-to-Node command. Distribute signed release artifacts or use a pinned repository revision with checksum and signature verification. Never disable TLS verification.
Replace the kill command with a Paperclip-managed process stop command, or display the owning process and require explicit confirmation before termination.
State clearly that local_trusted mode must remain loopback-bound and recommend authenticated mode for LAN or tailnet access.

content.value_statement: Running an AI-agent company requires clear oversight of people, work, budgets, and approvals. This skill turns board requests into guided Paperclip workflows with concise status summaries.
actual_capabilities: Lists Paperclip companies and summarizes the active company dashboard.
Guides company creation, CEO hiring, and board-approval setup.
Creates and maintains hiring plans and decision-log documents.
Lists, approves, rejects, or requests revisions for pending approvals.
Monitors tasks, agent status, work products, and monthly costs.
Builds web UI links and concise board-level reports.
limitations: Requires a running Paperclip server and configured API environment variables.
Can only manage data and actions exposed by the Paperclip API.
Does not install or bootstrap Paperclip without the separate setup reference.
Local trusted mode depends on the security of the host and network binding.

use_cases.title: Launch a new agent company
use_cases.description: Create a company, hire a CEO, and establish a decision log with board governance.

use_cases.title: Review operations weekly
use_cases.description: Summarize tasks, blocked work, approvals, agent activity, and spending for a board review.

use_cases.title: Control hiring changes
use_cases.description: Draft a hiring plan, compare agent configurations, and route proposed changes through approval.

prompt_templates.title: Check company status
prompt_templates.prompt: Show the current Paperclip company dashboard. Highlight blocked tasks, pending approvals, and monthly budget use.

prompt_templates.title: Create a company
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me create a Paperclip company named Northstar Studio. Ask for its mission and monthly budget before making changes.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a team
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a hiring plan for a small product team. Propose roles, reporting lines, responsibilities, and budgets. Present the plan for approval before hiring anyone.

prompt_templates.title: Run a board review
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a board review for the active company. Summarize agent activity, work products, risks, costs, pending approvals, and recommended next actions.

output_examples.input: What needs board attention this week?
output: Two approvals need decisions: a designer hire and a tool subscription.
One launch task is blocked by missing product requirements.
Spending is within budget, but the engineering team used 68 percent of its allocation.
Proposed roles: product manager, frontend engineer, and content strategist.
Each role includes a reporting line, core responsibilities, and a monthly budget.
The plan is ready for board review before any hire requests are submitted.

best_practices: Confirm company, budget, and scope before creating or changing records.
Review the latest API document or agent configuration before every update.
Use approval workflows for hires, budget changes, and cross-agent configuration changes.
anti_patterns: Do not use the skill against an untrusted or publicly exposed Paperclip endpoint.
Do not approve multiple actions without reviewing the affected agents and budgets.
Do not treat dashboard summaries as a substitute for reviewing important work products.

faq.question: What does this skill manage?
faq.answer: It manages companies, agents, approvals, tasks, costs, work products, and decision records in Paperclip.

faq.question: Does it install Paperclip?
faq.answer: No. Installation and server bootstrap use the separate Paperclip setup reference.

faq.question: What configuration is required?
faq.answer: A running Paperclip server, PAPERCLIP_API_URL, and usually PAPERCLIP_COMPANY_ID are required.

faq.question: Can it hire agents?
faq.answer: Yes. It can prepare hire requests and guide approvals according to the company governance settings.

faq.question: How does it protect changes?
faq.answer: It instructs the assistant to fetch the latest document or configuration before updating it.

faq.question: Can it monitor spending?
faq.answer: Yes. It can summarize total spending and break costs down by agent or project.
